description:
Coordinate on your agent team's SHARED task list. You are one teammate in a lead-spawned team; this list is visible to every teammate.

Actions:
- 'list': see all shared tasks (optionally filter by status: open / claimed / done). Do this first to find unclaimed work.
- 'add': append a new shared task (title required) for any teammate to claim — use this to hand a sub-problem to the team.
- 'claim': atomically take an open task (task_id required). If another teammate already claimed it you'll be told — pick a different one.
- 'complete': mark your claimed task done with a result summary (task_id required; put your findings in 'result' so the lead can merge them without re-running your work).
name: team_task

action.description: What to do with the shared task list.

result.description: Result summary when completing a task.
